text: Lesson 1 (begin) approved as the calibration lesson: 28 steps, stored in docs/v7/content-revision/lesson-01-begin.steps.md with its companion lesson-01-begin.meta.md. It is the reference for voice, depth, check style and step division for the remaining lessons. A check standing alone on its own step uses the full card and is exempt from the 637 limit. Content work resumes after the redesign.
scope: Lesson 1 calibration rewrite and step division
